title: LinkedIn adds new tools to fight fake profiles and bogus work histories | TechCrunch
summary: For starters, LinkedIn will now allow members to vouch for their colleagues and classmates, past or present. Plus, LinkedIn will expand its partnerships with more companies to allow members to showcase their verified identities beyond LinkedIn.
